title: Empty Anchor-Free Segment
statement: For every binary input $x$ and every configuration $c$ of the dual transducer on $x$, the run from $c$ reaches $c$ after zero steps and has no anchor-state visit at any time strictly before then. Thus it is an anchor-free segment of length $0$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration of the dual transducer on a binary input
replaced:
For every configuration $c$ of the dual transducer, running it for $0$ steps from $c$
reaches $c$ without visiting the anchor state strictly before, so $c$ to $c$ is a
segment of length $0$.
